prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: 4:3 website cinematic key frame
Input images: Image 1 is a composition-and-action reference only; retain its framing, pose, props, and room layout but do not retain its rendering, textures, color grading, or character design. Image 2 is the sole authoritative reference for visual style, character identity, facial design, line quality, materials, and color palette.
Primary request: completely repaint the scene from scratch as a clean Japanese TV-anime cel key frame. Keep Image 1's focused drawing action: the girl sits at the desk looking down and draws on the pen display with a stylus, with her other hand resting naturally on the device.
Subject: exactly the same cute young teen girl as Image 2: rounded youthful face, large clear layered blue eyes, tiny mouth, subtle blush, cold silver-white long hair, pink bows, petite light-chibi proportions, and loose pink cat-ear hoodie. Keep the safe everyday presentation.
Scene/backdrop: preserve Image 1's bedroom composition and recognizable objects, but recolor and redraw them using Image 2's clean airy palette. Use pale honey-blond wood, cream paper, strawberry milk pink, soft mint accents, and clear navy-blue only outside the night window.
Style/medium: bright modern Japanese TV animation cel art; thin stable clean linework; large perfectly flat textureless color fills; at most two simple hard-edged shadow levels; restrained clean highlights; crisp eyelashes and hair silhouettes; uncluttered production key-frame finish.
Lighting/mood: clearly readable gentle night scene with a bright clean interior, soft warm lamp light and cool window light, no muddy amber cast, no crushed dark brown shadows, quietly focused and adorable.
Composition/framing: preserve Image 1's exact 4:3 camera, perspective, character placement, desk, pen display, stylus, furniture geometry, and main prop positions. Keep both hands anatomically plausible and naturally attached.
Constraints: Image 2 alone controls identity, style, palette, skin clarity, and hair color. Image 1 controls only composition and action. Exactly one character, two arms, two hands, no extra fingers or limbs. All ages appropriate. No readable text, signature, logo, or watermark.
Avoid: oil painting, watercolor, gouache, painterly brushwork, canvas texture, paper grain, wood grain microtexture, film grain, noise, speckles, stains, dirty color, brown varnish, glossy dark wood, photorealistic materials, fog, haze, bloom, soft focus, airbrush gradients, granular shadows, micro-detail accumulation, mature proportions, sexualization, malformed hands, text, watermark.
